# Lab 17.11: Rotate & Disable a Key

## What We Are Going to Do
Set automatic rotation, rotate manually, then disable a key version and see the effect on data protected by it.

## Steps

1. **Turn on automatic rotation.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud kms keys update lab-key --keyring=lab-ring --location=us-central1 \
  --rotation-period=90d \
  --next-rotation-time=$(date -u -d '+90 days' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Rotate now.** Create a new primary version.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud kms keys versions create --key=lab-key --keyring=lab-ring \
  --location=us-central1 --primary
gcloud kms keys versions list --key=lab-key --keyring=lab-ring --location=us-central1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Version 2 is now primary. Version 1 stays enabled to decrypt older data.

3. **Write a new object.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">echo "new data" | gcloud storage cp - gs://$PROJECT_ID-cmek/new.txt
gcloud storage objects describe gs://$PROJECT_ID-cmek/new.txt --format="value(kms_key)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It uses version 2. `secret.txt` still uses version 1. Rotation does not re-encrypt old data.

4. **Disable version 1.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud kms keys versions disable 1 --key=lab-key --keyring=lab-ring --location=us-central1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Try to read the old object.** After a few minutes:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage cat gs://$PROJECT_ID-cmek/secret.txt</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It fails. `new.txt` still works. This is how you cut off access to data quickly.

6. **Enable it again.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud kms keys versions enable 1 --key=lab-key --keyring=lab-ring --location=us-central1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


7. **Understand destroy.** Destroying a version is scheduled, by default 30 days later, and data encrypted with it is lost forever. Do not destroy in this lab.

8. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage rm --recursive gs://$PROJECT_ID-cmek
gcloud kms keys update lab-key --keyring=lab-ring --location=us-central1 --remove-rotation-schedule</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Rotation | New data uses the new version |
| Old data | Still uses the old version |
| Disabled version | Data protected by it cannot be read |
| Destroy | Delayed, then permanent |
